# API Latency and Encryption Standards Review

This document details the ongoing requirements for maintaining and improving the bank's IT infrastructure and security protocols.

*   Optimize the API latency for strategy 2026.
*   Update the API latency standard based on audit findings.
*   Review the encryption standards quarterly.
